name: Organic Synthesis
description: Introduction to asymmetric synthesis, formation of carbon–carbon bonds, including organometallic reactions, synthetic applications of organoboranes and organosilanes, reactions at unactivated C–H bonds, oxidation reactions, reduction reactions, newer reagents in organic synthesis, design of organic synthesis, retrosynthetic analysis, selectivity in organic synthesis, protection and deprotection of functional groups, multistep synthesis of representative molecules.
